videos.title: The Afghan potato dish I grew up eating ❤️
videos.description:
This recipe takes me straight back to my childhood 🥹❤️ korma kichaloo is a comforting Afghan potato dish I learned from my mother, and I plan to keep making it until my daughter is old enough to complain that she's going to school smelling like my cooking, too 😜

Traditionally, this korma is enjoyed as a side dish, but you can also add lentils and serve it with rice to make a complete meal.
